{{Quote|Is he bringing additional warriors?|Lampay Fay asking Tion Medon if Obi-Wan Kenobi is bringing reinforcements|<ref name="Episode 3">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
'''Lampay Fay''' was a [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'an]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and the aide to [[Chairman of Utapau/Legends|Port Administrator]] [[Tion Medon/Legends|Tion Medon]] on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. Medon, Fay, and [[Zyn Javeb]] assisted [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during his search for [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].

==Biography==
Fay was a tall, gaunt being with lined, [[Color/Legends|gray]] skin and an imposing visage. Despite his disturbing appearance, Fay was helpful, and dealt with important duties in [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]] on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. It was said that Fay's ancestors were integral to the history of Utapau, and were partially credited with the current society forged by the Pau'ans and the [[Utai/Legends|Utai]].

[[Tion Medon/Legends|Tion Medon]], [[Zyn Javeb]], and Fay greeted [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] upon his arrival in Pau City. Lampay ensured Obi-Wan's [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Jedi interceptor]] was refueled while the Administrator talked with his guest.

==Behind the scenes==
Lampay Fay was portrayed by an uncredited [[Goran Kleut]] in his film debut.<ref name="Interviews">{{WebCite|url=https://starwarsinterviews.com/prequel-trilogy/episode-iii-revenge-of-the-sith/goran-kleut-lampay-fay|text=Goran Kleut (Lampa Fay)|author=[[Dennis Pellegrom]]|date=2010-09|work=[[Star Wars Interviews]]|archivedate=20220930161253|nolive=1}}</ref>
